1.) Login Page: 
The data fields we want in login page is 
• 
User-Name/Email = A unique identifier  
• 
Password = There account password 
 
 
2.) 
Signup Page: 
Sign-Up Page will be used when a new user will register on our application. In this case 
we want basic information: 
• 
userName – The name of the account that user want to keep 
• 
email – Email of the user. Must be Unique i.e. no existing account should have 
the same email. 
• 
Password – Account password that the user will use to login. This will be hashed 
before storing in the Database.  
• 
pfp – A profile picture like we have in social media applications like Instagram, 
Facebook etc. . 
 
eg : 
 
 
• 
role – The purpose of the user i.e. enum [ Rider| Organizer | Sponsor ]

These are the basic details of the user we want when signing them up. In the next page we 
ask for “Role-Specific” details. 
1.) Rider: 
• 
fName – First Name of the rider 
• 
mName – Middle Name of the rider (if applicable) 
• 
lName – Last Name of the rider 
• 
age 
• 
city 
• 
banner – An image like youtube banner.  
• 
socialLinks – Links of Rider’s social media accounts like Instagram, FaceBook, 
Youtube etc. . 
• 
bikes – An array of bikes which the rider owns. They can select from the 
dropdown we will provide to them. This information will be used when 
suggesting them rides. 
• 
ridingStyle – An array of preferred riding style by the rider, for eg some rider 
love cruising and off-roading while some can love adventure and highway rides 
etc. . 
• 
bio – A small description of the rider (Max 250 characters supported) 
2.) Organizer: 
• 
banner – An image representing their brand. This will be asked by the user. 
• 
name – Name of the organization  
•

2.) Organizer:

3.) Sponsors: 
• 
brandName – Name of the company 
• 
banner – Same as that of organizer

RIDESYNC

Ride together, explore more, and build your motorcycle community.

Get Started

ABOUT US

RideSync is a web platform built for motorcycle riders to connect, create rides, join events, and share real experiences. We built this platform because riders often struggle to find trusted local groups, ride updates, and event information in one place. RideSync solves that by bringing community, ride planning, and event discovery together in a single simple platform.

FEATURES

Create a Ride

Plan your own ride with route details, timing, and meeting point for other riders.

Join Ride

Browse upcoming rides near you and join solo or group rides with one click.

Community

Connect with riders, share updates, discuss bikes, and build your local riding network.

Track Events Around You

Stay updated with rallies, bike meets, night rides, and events happening around your area.
Stay updated with rallies, bike meets, night rides, and events happening around your area.

SPONSORS

These brands back RideSync so we can keep rides organized, share safety tips, and grow a trusted rider community. From gear to service, our sponsors help members ride smarter and explore further.

Royal Enfield

Supporting weekend rides and classic touring culture across our chapters.

Bajaj

Partner for urban commutes and group city rides with reliable everyday machines.

Hero MotoCorp

Helping new riders get started with training sessions and beginner-friendly routes.

Triumph

Triumph

Backing adventure and road-trip experiences for riders who love long-distance journeys.

Energy drinks partners

Long rides need focus and quick recovery at fuel stops. Our energy drink partners keep crews sharp on highways, hill climbs, and overnight rides—always hydrate and ride within your limits.

Red Bull

Fuels early-morning departures and track-day weekends—supporting rider meetups where timing, precision, and stamina matter.

FAQ

Common questions

Riders sign up and join rides for free. Some rides may have an entry fee set by the organizer (covers fuel, food, permits). Sponsorship is a paid partnership.
Most rides are open to any bike. Some rides are brand-locked (e.g. Royal Enfield only) — that's clearly shown on the ride details page before you book.

Sign up and pick "Organizer" as your role. You'll get access to the ride creation flow where you can set up rides, manage seats, and connect with sponsors.
Sponsors sign up, browse rides that fit their brand, and reach out to organizers directly through the platform. Terms are negotiated between sponsor and organizer.
Yes — passwords are hashed, sessions use secure cookies, and we never share your contact details with third parties without permission.
RideSync currently covers 15 cities across India, with new ones being added every month. Browse rides by city after signing up.

(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ══ STICKY NAVBAR ══ */
  const nav = document.getElementById('navbar');
  function onScroll() {
    if (window.scrollY > 30) nav.classList.add('scrolled');
    else nav.classList.remove('scrolled');
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
  onScroll();

  /* ══ REVEAL ON SCROLL ══ */
  const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
        revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' });

  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

Common questions

Riders sign up and join rides for free. Some rides may have an entry fee set by the organizer (covers fuel, food, permits). Sponsorship is a paid partnership.
Most rides are open to any bike. Some rides are brand-locked (e.g. Royal Enfield only) — that's clearly shown on the ride details page before you book.

Sign up and pick "Organizer" as your role. You'll get access to the ride creation flow where you can set up rides, manage seats, and connect with sponsors.
Sponsors sign up, browse rides that fit their brand, and reach out to organizers directly through the platform. Terms are negotiated between sponsor and organizer.
Yes — passwords are hashed, sessions use secure cookies, and we never share your contact details with third parties without permission.

  onScroll();

  const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
        revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' });

  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));
